title: The Design Value of Uptake Feedback for Complier Effects under a Placebo Budget
banked_reason: Sound partial manuscript below the fixed field floor: constructive_object_missing at sharp-values-and-feedback; achieved incremental, paper score ceiling 5.2<7.4. Independent terminal-validity confirmed bounded-route exhaustion; future retry needs materially new structure.
proof_attempt_summary: recursions, state-local posterior enclosures, and a capped four-atom/degree-seven construction. The local pilot narrowed the B=1 bracket by over 22%, but the final selected rule/prior gap was at least 0.01507665, above its 0.010 gate; the posterior LP had no feasible incumbent and the reachable cover was uncertified. The sharp adaptive/static values, moderate-budget feedback sign and contact geometry remain open; future retry requires materially new structure or certificates.
tldr: The all-original-policy experiment comparison and complete initial-information static comparator are retained. The final capped \(B=1\) contact-guided route does not reach common width \(0.010\). Exact actual-clipped risk and prior-ceiling certificates show its selected pair has a gap of at least \(0.01507665\). The best common minimax bracket stays \([0.03135644,0.04732]\); all retained feedback intervals contain zero. Matched moderate-budget values and least-favorable geometry remain open, conditional throughout on the stated physical uptake fidelity and endpoint-before-contact protocol.
gap: Compliance subsampling, placebo designs, and adaptive validation already address information costs. The objective here is a transferable finite-information original-CACE design value under selected-cell rare disclosure, with a converse against every original-record controller and a complete static comparator. Frangakis--Baker is an informed-by antecedent: its inaccessible theorem text prevents a claim of exclusion or improvement.
fill: The field-level deliverable combines uniform finite-stratum transfer and ordered nuisance removal, matched all-policy design certificates and original-record attainers, computable dimension-dependent certificate bounds, and evaluated adaptive/static values in the stated benchmark. Protocol error receives an explicit perturbation bracket. A generic control equation or an unevaluated \(K\)-stratum slogan does not meet this deliverable.
